company.name: Wayout International
company.shortDescription: Wayout offers profitable and sustainable water production microfactories for local coverage of perfect drinking water
company.description: Perfect drinking water should be a human right. Wayout offers profitable and sustainable water production microfactories for local coverage of perfect drinking water. By producing locally, the old harmful ways of transporting bottles across the planet are bypassed. With minimal eco footprint and minimal effort these microfactories can be operated locally by anyone. Any water source can be used and the microfactories can run on solar power. The water is perfected through double reverse osmosis, desalination, UV-treatment and remineralisation, with medical grade purity in every step. The entire system – microfactory, vessels and dispensers – is connected via the cloud, and all activities are logged and displayed on apps to meet the needs of the different stakeholders. A single microfactory produces affordable daily drinking water for 300 households while also removing up to 250.000 plastic bottles and 25 tons of carbon dioxide every month.
